No enrolment total, update cycle or link to the identity system is published.

progress: Mixed, the first automatic roll derived from the civil registry while that derivation reproduced the register's own omissions
summary: The [automatic electoral roll](2026-07-31-eleicoes26-cen-lanca-campanha-de-consulta-e-atualizacao-de-dados) carries 146,510 voters for the September 2026 elections, added after a process failure that had missed about 1,860 eligible voters.
developments:
The reform project closed in September 2025, the new system was ready in February 2026 and automatic registration was inaugurated in April ([project](2025-09-02-stp-encerra-projeto-reforma-sistema-eleitoral-prese), [system](2026-02-06-stp-pronto-novo-sistema-recenseamento-eleitoral), [inauguration](2026-04-30-prese-inaugura-recenseamento-automatico)).

The provisional roll carries 146,510 voters, added after a fix to the process failure ([roll](2026-07-31-eleicoes26-cen-lanca-campanha-de-consulta-e-atualizacao-de-dados)).

The finding is what the failure was: the first automatic derivation from the civil registry reproduced that register's own omissions. Automating a derivation inherits the source's gaps, and the electoral commission launched a consultation and update campaign in response. The data-protection authority supervises the interconnection, which is recorded separately.

summary: The taxpayer identifier is [required throughout company registration](2026-01-01-sao-tome-dgrn-guiche-unico-para-empresa), and a [February 2026 memorandum](2026-02-10-sao-tome-direccao-dos-impostos-memorando-turismo-e-factura) created a permanent data-sharing mechanism with the tourism directorate.
developments:
The company window requires the taxpayer card of the applicant and the identifier of shareholders and companies, and a negative certificate of tax debt to dissolve ([window](2026-01-01-sao-tome-dgrn-guiche-unico-para-empresa)), which is the identifier in operational use across another register.

The memorandum creates a permanent mechanism for sharing data on licensed tourism and hospitality businesses, cross-checking that firms are properly registered and tax-compliant and reinforcing the obligation to issue electronic invoices ([memorandum](2026-02-10-sao-tome-direccao-dos-impostos-memorando-turismo-e-factura)).

The credit facility review reports a domestic revenue mobilisation strategy covering VAT administration, large-taxpayer follow-up and digital tax systems ([review](2025-12-05-sao-tome-imf-country-report-25-347-second-review-ecf)). No register size, coverage of the informal economy or compliance rate is published.

summary: The property registry system held [105,535 entries at March 2024](2024-11-20-worldbank-sao-tome-institutional-capacity-isr-sirp-registo-propriedade) against a year-end target of 133,151, of an estimated 200,000 records to be catalogued.
developments:
The status report names the new information system, records 105,535 real estate and vehicle registries entered as at 15 March 2024 against a December 2024 target of 133,151, and states that the registries are estimated to hold about 200,000 records, 162,000 property and 38,000 vehicle, with at least 65 per cent to be digitalised and cataloguing ongoing ([status report](2024-11-20-worldbank-sao-tome-institutional-capacity-isr-sirp-registo-propriedade)).

It also flags a risk that the IT investments financed may not be sustainable without more skilled staff ([status report](2024-11-20-worldbank-sao-tome-institutional-capacity-isr-sirp-registo-propriedade)).

The directorate's own page lists the registrable acts on buildings and land and the certificates the registry issues, with fees by turnaround ([services](2026-01-01-sao-tome-dgrn-registo-predial-servicos)). No later count is held, so whether the December 2024 target was met is unestablished.

summary: National platform data for 2022 and 2023 was used to [estimate district-level incidence of three chronic diseases](2026-07-29-sao-tome-telanon-dhis2-dcnt-analise-distrital), the first analytic use of the system the base holds.
developments:
A public health masters dissertation used national platform data for 2022-2023, with health worker interviews, to estimate district-level incidence of hypertension, diabetes and stroke across five named districts, and recommends systematic use of the data to strengthen the chronic disease programme ([dissertation](2026-07-29-sao-tome-telanon-dhis2-dcnt-analise-distrital)).

That is analytic use of the system rather than a system upgrade or rollout ([dissertation](2026-07-29-sao-tome-telanon-dhis2-dcnt-analise-distrital)), and it is the first evidence held that the platform now carries data usable at district level.

The platform itself has run since December 2019 with a tracker module from 2020 ([platform](2020-01-01-sao-tome-ministerio-saude-sistema-informacao-saude-dhis2)), and was put out for independent evaluation in April 2026 alongside the supply and facilities systems ([evaluation](2026-04-29-sao-tome-pnud-avaliacao-sistema-informacao-saude)).

summary: The school management system is still at implementation stage, with [technical assistance tendered in April 2026](2026-04-01-sao-tome-afap-consultoria-implementacao-sige) and [supervision dashboards tendered in May](2026-05-07-sao-tome-unicef-dashboards-supervisao-educativa).
developments:
The completion report on the education project records the starting position - no reliable system linking the central ministry with decentralised structures across geographically dispersed schools - and the design, a system housed at the planning directorate with computer equipment installed centrally and a computer for data management in each primary school ([report](2019-12-24-worldbank-sao-tome-quality-education-for-all-icr-emis-sige)).

The sector compact records the system introduced and under joint development to link the central level and the districts ([compact](2023-06-01-sao-tome-gpe-pacto-parceria-educacao-sige)).

In April 2026 the procurement agency tendered technical assistance for its implementation ([assistance](2026-04-01-sao-tome-afap-consultoria-implementacao-sige)), and in May a United Nations agency tendered national supervision dashboards ([dashboards](2026-05-07-sao-tome-unicef-dashboards-supervisao-educativa)). Seven years after the completion report, implementation is still being procured.

summary: The [single social registry was relaunched in January 2026](2026-01-27-sao-tome-lancamento-ii-recertificacao-expansao-cadastro-social-unico) targeting about 12,000 vulnerable families, and the management system behind it is [fully government-operated](2025-09-12-sao-tome-banco-mundial-protecao-social-financiamento-adicional-kenon) for the first time.
developments:
The second recertification and expansion of the registry was launched on 27 January 2026 aiming to reach about 12,000 vulnerable families, up from eight thousand households, with 100 directorate technicians and 10 from the statistics institute in the field, and a six-stage process ending in an eligibility formula ([launch](2026-01-27-sao-tome-lancamento-ii-recertificacao-expansao-cadastro-social-unico)). The national coordinator describes the registry as the principal identification tool for beneficiaries of any social programme and as preventing duplicate benefits ([launch](2026-01-27-sao-tome-lancamento-ii-recertificacao-expansao-cadastro-social-unico)).

The project paper records the 2024 adoption of an open-source management information system, fully owned and operated by the government for the first time in the country's history, integrated with the registry ([project paper](2025-09-12-sao-tome-banco-mundial-protecao-social-financiamento-adicional-kenon)).

Coverage reported in August 2026 stands above 12,500 households ([coverage](2026-08-26-sao-tome-csu-social-registry-expansion)).

summary: A [digital-evidence capability](2026-06-27-sao-tome-unodc-digital-evidence-chain) across the criminal justice chain was completed in June 2026, over a [case-management system](2024-01-01-sao-tome-ministerio-publico-sistema-gestao-processual) financed since 2020 and still in development.
developments:
A five-week programme concluded on 26 June 2026 trained judicial police officers, prosecutors and judges on extraction and decryption tools procured for the judicial police and stated to be in operational use, alongside a review of the national legal framework against the international cybercrime convention ([programme](2026-06-27-sao-tome-unodc-digital-evidence-chain)).

The case-management system is piloted by the justice ministry with a multi-sector team from the supreme court, the first-instance court and the public prosecutor, implemented in two phases and covering the courts, the prosecutor, the two police forces and the prison service, with an interim spreadsheet-based digitalisation replacing the paper day-books ([system](2024-01-01-sao-tome-ministerio-publico-sistema-gestao-processual)). That page is undated and its year is inferred.

An AI access-to-justice platform with encrypted reporting routing to the judicial police is being built in parallel ([platform](2026-06-01-sao-tome-unodc-direitosaopovo-ai-justice-platform)).

summary: [3,866 taxpayers were registered on the VAT system](2025-12-24-sao-tome-world-bank-icr-institutional-capacity-building-project) at September 2024 with collections at 3.32 per cent of GDP, and [computing equipment](2026-08-18-rstp-sao-tome-pnud-equipamentos-direcao-geral-impostos) reached the tax directorate in August 2026.
developments:
The completion report gives the registration and collection figures and records 22 per cent of Treasury and central bank processes digitalized as of October 2025 after the core banking installation ([report](2025-12-24-sao-tome-world-bank-icr-institutional-capacity-building-project)).

Computing equipment was handed to the tax directorate in August 2026 by a United Nations agency under a European-funded regional programme, to modernise tax administration and the handling of fiscal data, with no value or delivery schedule stated ([handover](2026-08-18-rstp-sao-tome-pnud-equipamentos-direcao-geral-impostos)).

The directorate also signed a data-sharing memorandum with the tourism directorate in February 2026 reinforcing electronic invoicing ([memorandum](2026-02-10-sao-tome-direccao-dos-impostos-memorando-turismo-e-factura)). The tax line is the most evidenced government system in this unit and it is still under a quarter digitalised.

summary: An [integrated trade single window and customs system deployment](2026-01-25-salto-tecnologico-comercio-externo-janela-unica-asyfive) was announced with United Nations support in January 2026.
developments:
The announcement covers a port and external trade single window alongside a customs platform deployment ([announcement](2026-01-25-salto-tecnologico-comercio-externo-janela-unica-asyfive)).

No contract, value, timetable or go-live is published, and nothing has entered the base since. For an island economy dependent on port throughput, it is the highest-value government system announced in this period and the least evidenced.

progress: Mixed, the property registry system is loaded and cataloguing while the cadastral service was shut out of its own offices
summary: The property system held [105,535 entries at March 2024](2024-11-20-worldbank-sao-tome-institutional-capacity-isr-sirp-registo-propriedade); the cadastral service was [locked out of its premises in February 2026](2026-02-23-sao-tome-servicos-geograficos-cadastrais-paralisados) over three and a half years of unpaid state rent.
developments:
The status report records the property and vehicle registry system holding 105,535 entries against a December 2024 target of 133,151, an estimated 200,000 records in the registries, and a sustainability risk over skilled staffing ([status report](2024-11-20-worldbank-sao-tome-institutional-capacity-isr-sirp-registo-propriedade)).

The geographic and cadastral service was shut out of its rented premises after three and a half years of rent unpaid by the state, with the director barred from his office and staff sent home; the service has no financial autonomy, depends on the infrastructure ministry's administrative directorate, and still has no premises of its own ([report](2026-02-23-sao-tome-servicos-geograficos-cadastrais-paralisados)).

A donor-financed registry system is being loaded while the state service that maps what it registers cannot pay its rent.

summary: A [citizen portal](2026-03-28-inic-lanca-portal-do-cidadao) entered beta in March 2026, funded by a lender and a foundation with external technical advisory.
developments:
The beta was launched at the identity institute's eighteenth anniversary ([portal](2026-03-28-inic-lanca-portal-do-cidadao), [launch](2026-04-07 São Tomé and Príncipe Launches Citizen Portal)).

Two accounts frame the same launch differently — one as the institute's portal, the other as the lender and foundation's citizen portal — and they are treated here as one object.

No service count, user figure or exit-from-beta date is published. It sits on the same interoperability platform and digital identity prototypes recorded separately, none of which is confirmed delivered.

summary: The state's [data centre and government network date from 2008](2020-06-01-inic-sao-tome-estrategia-nacional-governacao-digital) with a fibre backbone begun in 2017; nothing held describes district-level infrastructure.
developments:
The digital governance strategy is the primary national statement of the state's own ICT estate: the government data centre and government network from 2008, the government fibre backbone begun in 2017, and the electronic civil registration system developed from 2016 ([strategy](2020-06-01-inic-sao-tome-estrategia-nacional-governacao-digital)).

The draft cybersecurity strategy adds that both were built with international cooperation ([cybersecurity strategy](2024-07-23-inic-sao-tome-estrategia-nacional-ciberseguranca-d3)).

Neither describes what reaches a district council, and the one sub-national plan held lists limited island digitalisation among its own constraints ([plan](2019-10-01-principe-2030-plano-desenvolvimento-sustentavel-regiao-autonoma)). The base carries a centre and a backbone and nothing about the last mile to local administration.

summary: The [autonomous region's own 2019 plan](2019-10-01-principe-2030-plano-desenvolvimento-sustentavel-regiao-autonoma) lists limited island digitalisation and the absence of a regional cadastre among its principal constraints, and no national instrument addresses district records.
developments:
The plan is the only located primary document by a sub-national government stating its own information position, listing limited digitalisation of the island and the absence of regional cartography and a cadastre among its constraints, with a territorial cadastre among its objectives ([plan](2019-10-01-principe-2030-plano-desenvolvimento-sustentavel-regiao-autonoma)).

No national instrument dedicated to digitising district or regional administrative records is held. The national cadastral service was meanwhile shut out of its own premises in February 2026 ([cadastral service](2026-02-23-sao-tome-servicos-geograficos-cadastrais-paralisados)), which is the practical answer to the plan's request.

Seven years on from the plan, the regional cadastre it asked for is not recorded as begun.

summary: [Vaccination data digitisation](2026-04-29-oms-sao-tome-semana-africana-vacinacao-digitalizacao-dados) went under test in three districts in April 2026 and a [teleconsultation platform](2026-06-15-sao-tome-piaui-saude-digital-teleconsulta-angolares-caue) opened at a district health centre from July.
developments:
The health cooperation strategy gives the peripheral inventory: 21 community health posts and 32 health posts at community level, six district health centres including the second island's regional hospital, and a central hospital level ([strategy](2023-07-01-oms-sao-tome-estrategia-cooperacao-pais-2023-2027)).

The health agency, with the ministry, is testing the digitalisation of vaccination data in three priority districts, its representative stating the aim as making information available in real time for faster decision-making ([test](2026-04-29-oms-sao-tome-semana-africana-vacinacao-digitalizacao-dados)).

A Brazilian state government installed a teleconsultation platform at the health centre in the capital of a southern district, connecting patients to practitioners in Brazil from 1 July 2026 with a mobile application, and it is to be extended to two further districts ([platform](2026-06-15-sao-tome-piaui-saude-digital-teleconsulta-angolares-caue)). Both reach the periphery; neither is a national programme.

summary: The school management system placed a [computer in each primary school](2019-12-24-worldbank-sao-tome-quality-education-for-all-icr-emis-sige) under the project that built it, and [implementation is being procured again](2026-04-01-sao-tome-afap-consultoria-implementacao-sige) in 2026.
developments:
The completion report records the starting position - no reliable system linking the ministry to decentralised structures in a context of geographically dispersed schools - and a design under which each primary school would receive a computer for data management and be connected ([report](2019-12-24-worldbank-sao-tome-quality-education-for-all-icr-emis-sige)).

Technical assistance for the system's implementation was tendered in April 2026 ([assistance](2026-04-01-sao-tome-afap-consultoria-implementacao-sige)), so the school-level layer is still being built out.

The only in-window delivery to rural schools the base holds is a union donation: four laptops handed over in January 2026, three of them to schools in two rural districts and the capital, with bags, webcams and mice from a private company ([donation](2026-01-29-fne-sao-tome-entrega-computadores-escolas-lemba-cantagalo)). It is a solidarity gesture, not a programme.

summary: Birth registration is now [entered electronically at every maternity unit in the country](2026-03-10-sao-tome-dgrn-registo-nascimento-electronico-maternidades), staffed by registry technicians and trained midwives, eliminating paper.
developments:
The chief conservator states that free registration up to one year is available in every maternity unit, staffed by directorate technicians and trained midwives, and that an electronic system allows registration to be entered directly into the database from computers and printers at those points ([registry](2026-03-10-sao-tome-dgrn-registo-nascimento-electronico-maternidades)).

The 2020 digital governance strategy records the electronic civil registration system as developed by the registries directorate and the identity institute from 2016 ([strategy](2020-06-01-inic-sao-tome-estrategia-nacional-governacao-digital)), so the reach to the maternity is the delivery of a decade-old build.

Registration at a maternity is not the same as a digitised district registry office, and nothing held describes the conservatories and district posts themselves ([services](2026-01-01-sao-tome-dgrn-registo-civil-servicos)).

summary: The police command and control system was to cover [only the capital district in a first phase](2023-06-27-unfpa-sao-tome-informatizacao-policia-nacional-sistema-zulu) from August 2023, and no source records its extension.
developments:
The agency reports delivering televisions to the national police for a computerisation and modernisation project creating a command and control centre including the system, with launch expected in the first half of August 2023, and states that in a first phase it would cover only the capital district and be extended gradually to the rest of the country ([report](2023-06-27-unfpa-sao-tome-informatizacao-policia-nacional-sistema-zulu)).

It also records about ten computers to be supplied and quotes the police strategic plan on computerising administrative and operational areas and linking the police information system to national and international crime databases ([report](2023-06-27-unfpa-sao-tome-informatizacao-policia-nacional-sistema-zulu)).

Three years on, nothing held records the extension beyond the capital, so the records system still does not reach a rural post on this evidence.

summary: An [AI access-to-justice platform](2026-06-01-sao-tome-unodc-direitosaopovo-ai-justice-platform) is being built with the justice ministry, against a [data strategy that treats AI as an opportunity to explore](2025-07-01-inic-sao-tome-estrategia-politica-governanca-de-dados) rather than anything in operation.
developments:
The strategy sets objectives for responsible and ethical data use and data-based decision-making, and treats artificial intelligence as an opportunity to be explored using public data rather than as something already operating in the administration ([strategy](2025-07-01-inic-sao-tome-estrategia-politica-governanca-de-dados)).

An implementing partnership was agreed to build a platform for the justice ministry carrying a legal-information chatbot trained on national legislation and grounded through retrieval-augmented generation, plus two encrypted reporting modules routing to the judicial police ([platform](2026-06-01-sao-tome-unodc-direitosaopovo-ai-justice-platform)).

A two-day training on digitalisation and artificial intelligence for the public administration ran in April 2026 ([training](2026-04-22-rstp-pnud-capacitacao-digitalizacao-inteligencia-artificial)). The first deployment is public-facing and in justice, ahead of any internal administrative use the base can see.

summary: An [AI vector-control system](2022-01-01-undp-digital-x-zzapp-malaria-sao-tome-ai-vector-control) piloted for malaria operations in 2022 covered more than 160,000 people; nothing records it since.
developments:
The entry describes a system that plans, assigns, executes and monitors anti-malaria operations, with the model analysing satellite imagery to locate houses and probable breeding sites and climate data to recommend timing, and field data uploading back into it ([entry](2022-01-01-undp-digital-x-zzapp-malaria-sao-tome-ai-vector-control)).

It lists the country as active and records a 2022 pilot covering more than 160,000 people ([entry](2022-01-01-undp-digital-x-zzapp-malaria-sao-tome-ai-vector-control)). The page carries no publication date and the year is inferred from the pilot it reports.

It is an operations system rather than the national health management information system, which is a separate platform ([platform](2020-01-01-sao-tome-ministerio-saude-sistema-informacao-saude-dhis2)). No later source records the pilot continuing, ending or scaling.

summary: A [national access-to-justice platform](2026-06-01-sao-tome-unodc-direitosaopovo-ai-justice-platform) with a chatbot trained on the country's own legislation was agreed in June 2026 with the justice ministry.
developments:
The implementing partnership covers a platform carrying a legal-information chatbot trained on national legislation and grounded through retrieval-augmented generation, plus two encrypted reporting modules routing to the judicial police, under a peacebuilding programme ([platform](2026-06-01-sao-tome-unodc-direitosaopovo-ai-justice-platform)).

Training a model on the national statute book is the first instance in this unit of an AI system built around domestic material rather than deployed as a foreign product ([platform](2026-06-01-sao-tome-unodc-direitosaopovo-ai-justice-platform)).

The consulate-reported citizenship-fund contract names an AI factory and an AI academy among its planned builds, on that page's own claims with no counterparty document located ([contract](2025-10-13-sao-tome-consulate-berlin-atlas-sovereign-iopn-ai-investment)). Nothing held records either as begun.

summary: There is [no AI law and no national AI ethics body](2026-01-22-unesco-sao-tome-ai-ethics-governance-country-profile); the data protection law and its authority are the only anchors, and the identity institute's guidelines carry no force of law.
developments:
The country profile states that no AI-specific laws or regulations govern development, use or deployment, and that there is consequently no national AI ethics commission or dedicated governance structure ([profile](2026-01-22-unesco-sao-tome-ai-ethics-governance-country-profile)).

It names the personal data protection framework and its authority as the relevant anchors and notes that the identity institute can issue strategies and guidelines that do not carry the force of law ([profile](2026-01-22-unesco-sao-tome-ai-ethics-governance-country-profile)).

The readiness assessment recommends an AI law by 2027 or 2028 ([assessment](2025-01-01-unesco-sao-tome-principe-ai-readiness-assessment)). The first public-facing AI system is meanwhile in build ([platform](2026-06-01-sao-tome-unodc-direitosaopovo-ai-justice-platform)), so the sequence here is deployment first.

progress: No change, a first count with no earlier figure behind it
summary: The business census counts [six enterprises in information and communication](2021-11-01-sao-tome-ine-ii-recenseamento-empresarial-2020), 0.6 per cent of the total, employing 209 people.
developments:
The statistics institute's second business census puts section J, information and communication, at 6 enterprises, 0.6 per cent of the total, and its employment table captioned 2019 gives 209 persons at service in that section, 152 men and 57 women ([census](2021-11-01-sao-tome-ine-ii-recenseamento-empresarial-2020)).

That is the domestic information and communication industry as the country's own statistics office measures it ([census](2021-11-01-sao-tome-ine-ii-recenseamento-empresarial-2020)). No earlier count is held, so no direction can be stated.

Set against it, the accredited higher-education register carries four computing and telecommunications degrees ([register](2026-01-01-sao-tome-desc-indice-cursos-acreditados)) and the university graduated at least 94 students across all fields in the window ([graduation](2026-08-24-sao-tome-ustp-gradua-94-estudantes-tecnologias)) - a training pipeline feeding a sector of six firms.

summary: The [incubator network](2021-07-21-sao-tome-mjde-incubadoras-de-negocios-em-stp-reina) built by the entrepreneurship ministry with a development agency, the mobile operator and a bank is [operating as an intake point](2026-07-29-rstp-sao-tome-terceira-edicao-empreende-mais-empreendedorismo-feminino) for the third startup competition.
developments:
The ministry describes the network as structured physical spaces on both islands with meeting rooms, internet and access to tools and equipment, offering business management support, technical support and complementary training, aimed at students, scientists, entrepreneurs and firms developing technology-based projects ([network](2021-07-21-sao-tome-mjde-incubadoras-de-negocios-em-stp-reina)).

The third competition names the incubator in the capital as one of three intake points alongside the district councils and an online form ([competition](2026-07-29-rstp-sao-tome-terceira-edicao-empreende-mais-empreendedorismo-feminino)), which is dated in-window confirmation that it is operating.

No count of incubated firms, occupancy figure, funding line or second location is published, so how much of the network described in 2021 exists on the ground is unestablished.

summary: The startup competition reached its [third edition in July 2026](2026-07-29-rstp-sao-tome-terceira-edicao-empreende-mais-empreendedorismo-feminino) focused on women-led entrepreneurship, having funded [four projects from US$8,000 to US$12,000](2025-11-30-rstp-sao-tome-bassola-pet-vence-empreende-mais-segunda-edicao) in the second.
developments:
The earlier innovation fund awarded up to US$5,000 each to 26 projects from a fund of US$130,000, drawing 456 valid applications, forming five training classes and taking 27 of a further 73 applications into incubation ([fund](2021-01-01-sao-tome-mjde-concurso-inovacao-startups-ideias-novos-negocios)).

The second edition drew more than 150 applications, selected 33 young people for five weeks of intensive training with due-diligence visits, and funded four projects at US$12,000, US$10,000 and two at US$8,000 ([second edition](2025-11-30-rstp-sao-tome-bassola-pet-vence-empreende-mais-segunda-edicao)).

The third launched in July 2026 focused on women-led entrepreneurship, run by the finance ministry's entrepreneurship directorate with the incubator network and development-agency financing, over four phases from registration to a final pitch ([third edition](2026-07-29-rstp-sao-tome-terceira-edicao-empreende-mais-empreendedorismo-feminino)). Three editions on donor money and no domestic funding line.

summary: Registry and electoral technicians were [trained in web and API development](2025-09-02-sao-tome-prese-formacao-web-webapi-recenseamento-automatico) in September 2025 to maintain the new registration system, and a [two-day AI and digitalisation intensive](2026-04-22-rstp-pnud-capacitacao-digitalizacao-inteligencia-artificial) followed in April 2026.
developments:
The training in web and API development was delivered by a Portuguese university to technicians of the registries directorate and the electoral commission so they would have technical autonomy to manage and maintain the new automatic electoral registration system ([training](2025-09-02-sao-tome-prese-formacao-web-webapi-recenseamento-automatico)). Certificates were awarded at a public session in September 2025 ([session](2025-09-09-sao-tome-prese-plataforma-recenseamento-automatico-registo-civil)).

A development agency ran a two-day intensive for the public administration on inclusive digital transformation, digital public infrastructure, ethics, governance, data management and protection, and practical AI applications, financed by a bilateral agency ([intensive](2026-04-22-rstp-pnud-capacitacao-digitalizacao-inteligencia-artificial)).

Training built around one system's maintenance is the more consequential of the two, and it is the only instance held of a handover designed around who keeps the system running.

summary: [Twenty-four laptops and projection equipment](2025-10-09-sao-tome-ergues-entrega-equipamentos-escolas-tic) reached technical-vocational schools in three districts in October 2025; the only survey measure held is [adolescent ICT skills](2019-01-01-sao-tome-ine-mics6-2019-resumo-estatistico), not a population rate.
developments:
The equipment - 24 laptops, four projectors, four pairs of speakers and four projection screens - went to dual-certification technical-vocational schools in two rural districts and the autonomous region, stated as strengthening ICT teaching and integrating digital literacy into practice ([handover](2025-10-09-sao-tome-ergues-entrega-equipamentos-escolas-tic)).

The only survey-based measure the base holds is the percentage of girls and boys aged 15 to 19 able to carry out at least one of nine listed computer activities, reported as a development indicator ([survey](2019-01-01-sao-tome-ine-mics6-2019-resumo-estatistico)). It is adolescent-specific, not a whole-population rate, and the extracted figures are positionally garbled in the capture so none is restated here.

Adapted computer equipment also reached an association for blind and partially sighted people in June 2026 ([donation](2026-06-09-sao-tome-cst-equipamentos-informaticos-adaptados-acastep)).

summary: A [tender for 80 tablets and 90 desktops](2026-07-30-unicef-aquisicao-de-tablets-computadores-e-acessorios-sistema-educativo-stp) for school computer rooms closed in August 2026, under a national digital learning programme, alongside a [school connectivity plan](2025-01-25-cst-35-anos-expansao-rede-conectividade-escolas) announced in 2025.
developments:
The equipment tender was opened by a United Nations agency and closed on 12 August 2026 ([tender](2026-07-30-unicef-aquisicao-de-tablets-computadores-e-acessorios-sistema-educativo-stp), [procurement](2026-07-30-unicef-aquisicao-de-tablets-computadores-e-acessorios-sistema-educativo-stp)).

The operator's school connectivity plan would expand fibre and mobile to schools, larger schools first, working with the education ministry; it predates the window and no follow-up source is found ([plan](2025-01-25-cst-35-anos-expansao-rede-conectividade-escolas)).

One hundred and seventy devices is the whole of the country's school digital equipment programme on this record, and the connectivity that would make them useful is an unfollowed announcement.

summary: The national register carries [four accredited computing and telecommunications degrees](2026-01-01-sao-tome-desc-indice-cursos-acreditados) across three institutions; the university's interim rector [named financing and infrastructure as persistent challenges](2026-05-23-sao-tome-ustp-reitor-interino-investimento-ciencia-digitalizacao) in May 2026.
developments:
The higher education directorate's register states that only enrolments in duly accredited courses are legally recognised, and lists computing engineering at two institutions and telecommunications and computing engineering and business computing at a third ([register](2026-01-01-sao-tome-desc-indice-cursos-acreditados)). It says nothing about facilities, enrolment or graduate numbers, and carries no publication date.

At the university's twelfth anniversary the interim rector stated that challenges persist in financing, infrastructures, scientific research, digitalisation, internationalisation and academic quality, and identified a shortage of teaching staff and low investment in science and innovation as principal difficulties ([anniversary](2026-05-23-sao-tome-ustp-reitor-interino-investimento-ciencia-digitalizacao)).

Four accredited qualifications and a stated staffing shortage is the whole of what the base holds on university capacity.

summary: A computing graduate built the labour directorate's [first digital platform during a paid traineeship](2025-11-04-sao-tome-estagio-remunerado-stp-doc-engenharia-informatica); the university [graduated at least 94 students](2026-08-24-sao-tome-ustp-gradua-94-estudantes-tecnologias) in August 2026 with no breakdown by field.
developments:
A graduate in computing engineering and a colleague built [a document platform holding more than 10,000 documents, described as the labour directorate's first, during a six-month paid traineeship](2025-11-04-sao-tome-estagio-remunerado-stp-doc-engenharia-informatica). The same report states that the traineeship programme served more than 300 young people in a first phase and 60 in a second, supported by a development agency ([traineeship](2025-11-04-sao-tome-estagio-remunerado-stp-doc-engenharia-informatica)).

The university graduated at least 94 students, 79 of them women, covering the 2022 to 2026 academic years across seven named course groups including technologies, with no breakdown of how many graduated in technologies or computing engineering ([graduation](2026-08-24-sao-tome-ustp-gradua-94-estudantes-tecnologias)).

No official publication counts graduates by field, ICT graduate destinations, or the size of the national ICT professional workforce ([yearbook](2017-01-01-sao-tome-ine-stp-em-numeros-2017)), so the pipeline into a sector of six firms cannot be measured.

summary: The [identity institute's revised statutes](2021-09-29-sao-tome-estatutos-inic-instituto-inovacao-conhecimento) give it autonomy and a research and policy-advice mandate, and a [national scientific repository](2026-03-25-sao-tome-lancamento-repositorio-cientifico-nacional-cplp) launched in March 2026.
developments:
The statutes, approved in Council of Ministers in September 2021 and revoking the institute's 2008 founding decree, give it scientific, administrative, financial and asset autonomy under the Prime Minister, and state its purpose as implanting the information and knowledge society, promoting research and technological innovation, and coordinating the design of all state information systems ([statutes](2021-09-29-sao-tome-estatutos-inic-instituto-inovacao-conhecimento)). Its listed competences include recommending draft laws and budget provision on ICT matters and operating an excellence centre.

The national scientific repository launched by videoconference alongside a common regional repository that has run since 2021 and aggregates more than two and a half million documents ([repository](2026-03-25-sao-tome-lancamento-repositorio-cientifico-nacional-cplp)).

No think tank, university department or research programme is recorded producing digital policy analysis. The mandate sits with the institute that also builds the systems.

summary: A [project grievance mechanism](2024-08-21-sao-tome-afap-canais-informacao-sugestoes-reclamacoes) runs a green line and complaint boxes across every district, and a [youth participation platform](2026-06-16-sao-tome-u-report-cinco-anos-lancamento-u-report-raparigas) passed 12,000 users in June 2026.
developments:
The procurement agency publishes a grievance mechanism with a green line, a general complaints number, a general and per-project email address including one for the digital project, and named physical complaint boxes across all districts and the autonomous region in schools, health posts, district councils and community premises ([mechanism](2024-08-21-sao-tome-afap-canais-informacao-sugestoes-reclamacoes)).

It covers that agency's own projects rather than the administration as a whole, and no national integrated complaints portal or electronic complaints book was located ([mechanism](2024-08-21-sao-tome-afap-canais-informacao-sugestoes-reclamacoes)).

The youth platform marked five years in June 2026 with more than 12,000 young people connected, run by the youth institute with a United Nations agency, and launched a girls' channel described as a response to a request made by girls themselves ([platform](2026-06-16-sao-tome-u-report-cinco-anos-lancamento-u-report-raparigas)).

summary: Two districts turned resident-identified priorities into [completed works in six and a half months](2026-08-13-sao-tome-orcamento-participativo-cantagalo-lemba-piloto) through pilot participatory budgeting exercises.
developments:
The pilots paved a stretch of road in one district and built a new water capture and distribution system with a decanting process in another, with communities taking part at every stage from problem identification to choosing solutions and delivering the investments ([pilots](2026-08-13-sao-tome-orcamento-participativo-cantagalo-lemba-piloto)).

The project was run by two civil-society organisations with the two district councils, supported by a Portuguese municipality and European funding ([pilots](2026-08-13-sao-tome-orcamento-participativo-cantagalo-lemba-piloto)). The publisher is the partner municipality rather than a national body, and the source describes pilot experiences rather than a national system.

The regulator's two public consultations are the only other participation route held ([consultation](2025-09-01-ager-sao-tome-consulta-publica-estrategia-nacional-ciberseguranca)), and neither records what it changed.

summary: The national gender-violence response protocol was [revised to include digital violence](2025-09-25-sao-tome-unfpa-validacao-fluxos-vbg-violencia-digital), and the 2025 activism campaign was [themed on digital violence against women and girls](2025-11-25-sao-tome-16-dias-ativismo-violencia-digital-mulheres).
developments:
The validation seminar for the response, protection and justice protocol was held in September 2025 with more than 80 participants, led by the justice ministry with the public prosecutor, a domestic-violence body and a United Nations agency; the source states the guide innovates by including terminology on digital violence and concepts relating to the LGBTQI+ public ([seminar](2025-09-25-sao-tome-unfpa-validacao-fluxos-vbg-violencia-digital)).

The activism campaign opened in November 2025 under a theme on ending digital violence against all women and girls, with the source stating that numerous cases of abuse and rights violations in digital spaces have been recorded ([campaign](2025-11-25-sao-tome-16-dias-ativismo-violencia-digital-mulheres)).

The financial inclusion series is the one place a gender gap is measured and narrowing: the women's index rose to 0.34 from 0.18 and the banking gap fell to 4.8 points from 20 ([survey](2026-02-20-sao-tome-afi-second-demand-side-survey-financial-inclusion)).

summary: The [national sign-language dictionary](2025-09-24-sao-tome-ergues-dicionario-lingua-gestual-qr-code) gained a QR code for online access in its second edition, and [adapted computer equipment](2026-06-09-sao-tome-cst-equipamentos-informaticos-adaptados-acastep) reached a blind persons' association in June 2026.
developments:
The second editions of the sign-language dictionary and a Portuguese manual for deaf pupils were launched in September 2025 under a bilateral cooperation project; the dictionary is organised in 21 thematic areas with 470 gestures and now includes a QR code allowing access through the internet ([launch](2025-09-24-sao-tome-ergues-dicionario-lingua-gestual-qr-code)).

The incumbent operator handed adapted computer equipment to an association of blind and partially sighted people, winner of its own competition, stating the purpose as facilitating access to information technologies; the association's president said it continues to work for approval of the regulation of the disability law ([handover](2026-06-09-sao-tome-cst-equipamentos-informaticos-adaptados-acastep)).

A disability law whose implementing regulation is still unapproved is the standing position behind both.

summary: The [2012 universal service decree](2012-08-20-sao-tome-decreto-lei-19-2012-servico-universal-telecomunicacoes) defines the service's scope and its financing fund, and is the operative instrument; no disbursement or coverage obligation is held.
developments:
The decree defines the scope of the universal telecommunications service and establishes the price-setting and financing regimes applicable to it, and is the basis of the universal service fund ([decree](2012-08-20-sao-tome-decreto-lei-19-2012-servico-universal-telecomunicacoes)). The same gazette issue carries decrees on international call control and SIM card registration.

Nothing held records a disbursement from the fund, a designated provider's obligations, or a coverage target set under it ([decree](2012-08-20-sao-tome-decreto-lei-19-2012-servico-universal-telecomunicacoes)). The copy is hosted by the regional regulators' association; no copy was located on a government site.

What has reached under-served places instead is a satellite service ([satellite](2025-12-11-starlink-begins-service-stp)) and the operator's own antenna programme ([antenna](2026-03-27-cst-inaugura-antena-agua-ize)).

summary: The [third national statistics strategy](2025-01-01-sao-tome-ine-ende-2025-2029) covers 2025 to 2029, succeeding plans for 2009 to 2018 and 2018 to 2021.
developments:
The strategy sets medium-term priorities for the national statistical system and states that it succeeds the two earlier strategies ([strategy](2025-01-01-sao-tome-ine-ende-2025-2029)). The document carries no explicit publication date and the year is taken from its own period.

The system it plans for rests on a 1998 statute ([law](1998-08-31-sao-tome-lei-5-98-bases-do-sistema-estatistico-nacional)) and has since returned to the field with a census ([census](2025-07-01-sao-tome-ine-v-rgph-2024-resultados)) and a household budget survey ([survey](2026-03-26-sao-tome-ine-inquerito-orcamentos-familiares-terreno)).

No execution report against the strategy is held, and the note recorded against the previous plan is that it was 52.8 per cent physically executed ([strategy](2025-01-01-sao-tome-ine-ende-2025-2029)).

summary: The [fifth census](2025-07-01-sao-tome-ine-v-rgph-2024-resultados) was enumerated in late 2024 and its results published in July 2025, and the [household budget survey returned to the field](2026-03-26-sao-tome-ine-inquerito-orcamentos-familiares-terreno) in March 2026 after nine years.
developments:
The census results report is the census itself rather than news of it, reporting population, household, housing and demographic results by district, with enumeration from 15 November to 15 December 2024 ([census](2025-07-01-sao-tome-ine-v-rgph-2024-resultados)).

The statistics institute returned to the field with a new household budget survey nine years after the 2017 round, with more than a hundred enumerators across the territory over two months collecting spending on education, health, food and transport, results expected by year end ([survey](2026-03-26-sao-tome-ine-inquerito-orcamentos-familiares-terreno)).

A new phase of tourism satellite accounts work opened in February 2026 with a national tourism survey at its centre, six of the ten accounts tables already complete ([accounts](2026-02-18-uneca-sao-tome-national-tourism-survey-tsa-new-phase)). Three field operations in eighteen months is the densest statistical activity this base holds for the country.

summary: An [automatic electoral registration law](2026-04-01-sao-tome-lei-recenseamento-eleitoral-automatico-entra-em-vigor) came into force in March 2026 entering citizens ex officio from registry data - the clearest case held of an administrative dataset driving an official register.
developments:
The law was published in the gazette on 26 March 2026 and establishes an automatic and permanent registration model under which citizens are entered in the electoral database on reaching 18, on the basis of data sharing between the registries directorate and the electoral commission ([law](2026-04-01-sao-tome-lei-recenseamento-eleitoral-automatico-entra-em-vigor)).

The health ministry's statistical yearbook is the clearest recurring publication compiled from routine service records rather than a survey, developed by the health information system office with a statistics institute representative on its working team ([yearbook](2021-01-01-sao-tome-ministerio-saude-anuario-estatistico-saude-2021)).

A 2025 enterprise survey was catalogued in January 2026, the first firm-level survey since 2014 ([survey](2026-01-12-world-bank-sao-tome-enterprise-survey-2025)). What administrative data has not produced is a published series: the registers carry counts and the base holds no regular statistical output from them.

summary: A civil-society [citizen's budget for 2026](2025-12-01-cipstp-orcamento-do-cidadao-stp-2026) reuses the official budget law, summarising how the State plans to raise and spend public resources.
developments:
The citizen's budget was built from the budget law as gazetted and links to the full official text, and states that it is intended to meet the budget transparency index ([citizen's budget](2025-12-01-cipstp-orcamento-do-cidadao-stp-2026)).

It is a civil-society reuse of official data rather than a government open data portal or an approved open data policy ([citizen's budget](2025-12-01-cipstp-orcamento-do-cidadao-stp-2026)), and no portal or policy is held.

The other published series a reuser could reach are the regulator's sector statistics ([statistics](2024-11-01-sao-tome-ager-observatorio-estatistico-2023)) and the central bank's payment series ([payments](2026-08-28-sao-tome-bcstp-estatisticas-do-sistema-de-pagamentos)), neither offered as data.

summary: A national working group was [trained on a land-cover assessment tool](2018-07-01-sao-tome-unccd-relatorio-pais-neutralidade-degradacao-terras) for the land-degradation programme in 2018; no operational agricultural earth-observation service is held.
developments:
The country report records that the national multisectoral working group was trained in and used the tool to assess land occupation and land-occupation change, with country-level land-cover data collected through it as one of three programme indicators, and names the agriculture ministry among the working-group institutions ([report](2018-07-01-sao-tome-unccd-relatorio-pais-neutralidade-degradacao-terras)).

That is a reporting exercise reaching agricultural land use, not a standing service ([report](2018-07-01-sao-tome-unccd-relatorio-pais-neutralidade-degradacao-terras)). Nothing since records a repeat assessment, a national geospatial programme or an agricultural monitoring product.

The cadastral service that would hold the land base was shut out of its premises in February 2026 ([cadastral service](2026-02-23-sao-tome-servicos-geograficos-cadastrais-paralisados)).

summary: A [US$2.6 million investment](2026-06-01-soff-sao-tome-approved-investment) was approved in June 2026 to upgrade the observation network, after [equipment reached the second island](2026-01-16-sao-tome-waca-mais-materiais-meteorologia-principe) in January completing its first aeronautical station.
developments:
The peer review of the meteorological service, prepared in consultation with the national institute, documents its forecasting, observation and warning capability and the satellite products it draws on ([review](2024-05-01-soff-knmi-sao-tome-country-hydromet-diagnostics)).

Equipment installed for the second island's meteorology delegation included a present-weather sensor measuring visibility and coding the weather, redundant pressure sensors and a tide gauge, after earlier installations at two ports, described by the observer as the island's first complete aeronautical station ([installation](2026-01-16-sao-tome-waca-mais-materiais-meteorologia-principe)).

The approved investment upgrades two automatic weather stations and rehabilitates one upper-air station with training and management support, moving the country into the investment phase for global observation compliance ([investment](2026-06-01-soff-sao-tome-approved-investment)). Both concern ground observation rather than satellite reception; no source describes a satellite product in operational use.

summary: There is [no bilateral investment or taxation treaty](2025-01-01-us-state-department-sao-tome-investment-climate-statement-2025) and the development finance corporation has run no programmes; a [fiftieth-anniversary reception](2026-08-26-us-embassy-sao-tome-250-years-and-50-years-diplomatic-relations) was held in August 2026.
developments:
The State Department's country statement records bilateral investment treaties with four other states but none with the United States and no bilateral taxation treaty, that the development finance corporation is authorised to do business in the country but has run no programmes there, and that a threshold programme from 2007 to 2011 established a modern customs code ([statement](2025-01-01-us-state-department-sao-tome-investment-climate-statement-2025)).

A charge d'affaires visited in January 2026, meeting the prime minister and the defence minister, with discussions including the recent launch of the satellite internet service ([visit](2026-01-28-us-embassy-charge-daffaires-cazeau-sao-tome-partnership-visit)).

The August 2026 reception marked fifty years of relations, with the delegation visiting the coastguard headquarters and maritime operations control centre and the release naming the satellite service among recent initiatives ([reception](2026-08-26-us-embassy-sao-tome-250-years-and-50-years-diplomatic-relations)). No hyperscaler is named in any of it.

summary: Relations resumed under a [2016 joint communique](2016-12-26-china-mfa-sao-tome-joint-communique-resumption-diplomatic-relations) and were [elevated to a strategic partnership](2024-09-05-china-mfa-xi-jinping-meets-prime-minister-sao-tome-strategic-partnership) in 2024; the window carries [a medical donation](2026-02-04-china-embassy-sao-tome-entrega-medicamentos-equipamentos-medicos) and the close of a medical mission.
developments:
The 2016 communique resumes ambassadorial-level relations with immediate effect and records the country's recognition of one China and its undertaking to have no official relations or contacts with Taiwan ([communique](2016-12-26-china-mfa-sao-tome-joint-communique-resumption-diplomatic-relations)). It is the founding instrument of the current relationship.

The joint declaration of 5 September 2024 that elevated relations to a strategic partnership runs to nine points, committing both sides to deeper Belt and Road cooperation and to a stable expansion into what it names as new areas — the digital economy, green development and the blue economy — alongside agriculture, health and infrastructure, with no project, instrument or sum stated ([declaration](2024-09-05-china-sao-tome-joint-statement-strategic-partnership)).

In February 2026 the ambassador and the health minister signed the delivery certificate for a donation of essential medicines, surgical instruments and hospital equipment ([donation](2026-02-04-china-embassy-sao-tome-entrega-medicamentos-equipamentos-medicos)), and in March the ministry awarded certificates of merit to the nineteenth Chinese medical team on the conclusion of its mission ([mission](2026-03-02-china-embassy-sao-tome-19a-equipa-medica-certificado-merito)). Health, not digital, is the whole of the in-window content.

summary: A [new four-year fisheries protocol](2025-10-06-european-commission-dg-mare-sao-tome-fisheries-protocol-2025-2029) worth 3.3 million euros was signed in October 2025, over a [2021-2027 indicative programme](2024-01-01-eeas-eu-delegation-european-union-and-sao-tome-and-principe) mobilising 13 million euros to 2024.
developments:
The delegation's country record states that relations are governed by the partnership agreement, describes a partnership dialogue in May 2024, sets out the multiannual indicative programme with 13 million euros mobilised for 2021-2024 across governance, green transition and human development, and records about 5.3 million euros more through regional programmes ([record](2024-01-01-eeas-eu-delegation-european-union-and-sao-tome-and-principe)).

The protocol's own text splits its 3.3 million euros over four years into 325,000 euros a year for access against a reference tonnage of 6,500 tonnes and 500,000 euros a year of sectoral support, the latter funding monitoring, control and surveillance against illegal fishing, scientific stock assessment and the value chain ([protocol](2025-07-09-eur-lex-com2025-369-sao-tome-fisheries-protocol-full-text)); it applies provisionally from 6 October 2025 ([signature](2025-10-06-european-commission-dg-mare-sao-tome-fisheries-protocol-2025-2029)).

The digital content of the relationship sits in the electoral reform project, which built the registration platform and trained the technicians who maintain it ([project](2025-09-09-sao-tome-prese-plataforma-recenseamento-automatico-registo-civil)).

summary: A consulate reports a [citizenship-fund contract](2025-10-13-sao-tome-consulate-berlin-atlas-sovereign-iopn-ai-investment) to mobilise up to ten billion dollars for a data centre, an AI factory and digital identity, over a [2017 air transport agreement](2017-10-29-uae-mofa-sao-tome-air-transport-services-agreement).
developments:
The air transport services agreement was signed in October 2017 by the head of the Emirati civil aviation authority and the country's then infrastructure minister, and is the clearest named signed Gulf bilateral instrument found on a signing party's own site ([agreement](2017-10-29-uae-mofa-sao-tome-air-transport-services-agreement)).

The consulate in Berlin states that the country's citizenship and investment unit has signed a contract with a company led by a technology partner to mobilise up to ten billion dollars over ten years and to build a modular data centre, a certified AI academy, an AI factory, digital identity systems, a digital finance ministry and a free trade zone, funded from the citizenship-by-investment programme through a new national transformation fund ([contract](2025-10-13-sao-tome-consulate-berlin-atlas-sovereign-iopn-ai-investment)).

The figure and the scope are that page's own claims, no counterparty document was located, and the page is written in German ([contract](2025-10-13-sao-tome-consulate-berlin-atlas-sovereign-iopn-ai-investment)). Nothing records any of it as begun.

summary: A [consolidated country brief](2026-03-31-india-mea-bilateral-brief-india-sao-tome-and-principe) lists agreements from 2009 to 2018 and names an Indian vendor's work on the national digital identity and citizen portal.
developments:
The brief records a protocol for foreign office consultations signed in December 2009, an agreement for economic cooperation and a memorandum on traditional medicines signed in March 2018, a framework agreement on space cooperation signed in September 2018, signature and ratification of the solar alliance framework, a 50kW solar installation at the prime minister's office, six school buses gifted in April 2025 and five occasions of humanitarian medical assistance ([brief](2026-03-31-india-mea-bilateral-brief-india-sao-tome-and-principe)).

It also records an Indian firm's open-source-based national digital identity and citizen portal work, funded by the lender and a digital public infrastructure centre ([brief](2026-03-31-india-mea-bilateral-brief-india-sao-tome-and-principe)) - the same integrator a lender mission names on the identity build ([mission](2025-09-17-world-bank-ajuda-memoria-stp-digital-setembro-2025)).

The in-window activity is a workshop marking the tenth Ayurveda day in September 2025 under the 2018 memorandum ([workshop](2025-09-23-embassy-of-india-sao-tome-ayurveda-day-2025-workshop)).

summary: There is [no open-data law, regulation or policy](2025-01-01-unesco-sao-tome-ai-readiness-assessment-full-report), against personal-data provisions that do exist, and no open government data portal.
developments:
The readiness assessment states plainly that no specific law or regulation on open data exists, while personal data — which it calls fundamental to developing artificial intelligence — is covered by the 2016 protection law ([assessment](2025-01-01-unesco-sao-tome-ai-readiness-assessment-full-report)).

Nothing else in the base names an open-data instrument, portal or dataset catalogue. The nearest published artefact is the [citizen's budget](2025-12-01-cipstp-orcamento-do-cidadao-stp-2026), which is a document rather than a portal. The absence is dated and searched rather than merely unexamined.
